Type: one-drawer end table
Use: bedside or sofa-side storage and surface; bedroom, living room
Style: mid-century modern, retro
Materials: walnut-stained wood, inlaid line pattern on drawer, brass knob and leg caps
Colors: warm dark walnut, brass gold
Shape: small rectangular box top with one drawer, four splayed round tapered legs with brass feet, compact and light
Feel: warm, refined, retro
Goes with: mustard, teal, cream walls, brass lamps; mid-century bedrooms or living rooms

product.name: Rivet Mid-Century Modern End Table, 15.75"W, Walnut Stain
product.description: Add a modern flair to your home with this stunning end table. With a rich walnut stain, gold-capped tapered legs, and a unique chevron inlay on the drawer’s front panel, this table exudes distinct personality and will capture attention in any room. 15.75"W x 11.81"D x 23.62"H Engineered hardwood and fiberboard with brown ash veneer; rubber-wood legs with gold metal caps Modern style, with gold-tipped tapered legs, a gold drawer knob to match leg accents, and a chevron-design inlay on the front drawer panel This side table features 1 gliding drawer for storage next to your couch or bed. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
